# Cinnabar Dust
The Arc Crusher (and its Array) crushes a block of Cinnabar into 2 Cinnabar Dust, and its other blocks (polished, bricks, chiseled, stairs, slabs and walls) into 1.
# Vermilion
One Cinnabar Dust crafts into 2 Red Dye.

# Roasting
Cinnabar Dust and Oxygen in the Chemical Reactor, heated to 600°C or more through its Heat faces: Mercury, and Sulfur Dioxide into the by-product tank.
# The contact process
Sulfur Dioxide, Oxygen and Water in the Chemical Reactor make Sulfuric Acid: a second route beside Sulfur Dust. By-product faces push the gas into Pressurized Conduits.

# Mercury
A heavy, bright liquid metal. Poured, it creeps a block or two and stops. Anything that steps in floats on it, and is poisoned unless it wears a full Hazmat Suit. It doesn't burn.
It's heavy and searching: only Tempered Fluid Tanks, Canisters and Fluid Conduits and up hold it. A network with a Wrought conduit in it won't carry it.

# Amalgamation
Raw Gold or Raw Silver dissolved in 100 mB of Mercury in the Chemical Reactor gives Gold or Silver Amalgam.
The Induction Furnace (not its Array) retorts an amalgam into 4 of that metal's Dust, one more than leaching, and gives 90 mB of the Mercury back into its by-product tank. Drain it through By-product faces.

# Mercury Vapour Lamp
An industrial light for floors, walls and ceilings: light level 15 in a cool blue-white while it has FE, dark without. It draws 4 FE/t from a conduit on any side but the bulb's. A redstone signal turns it off.
Four from a Mercury Bucket, four Glass and four Steel Plates.
